sm.$description: 640px. Number-typed so every platform emits a bare literal; a dimension would emit an invalid raw string into Swift and Kotlin. Value adopted from the installed Tailwind default, not invented — the repo already renders against it.

md.$description: 768px. Tablet-portrait class, and the width the view-context rail collapses at (authored as a 48rem @container threshold).

xl.$description: 1280px. The viewport the VRT and a11y-contract capture suites run at.

2xl.$description: 1536px. Zero 2xl: usages in the repo today; it ships so the scale is complete and the generated Tailwind screens map stays identical to the framework default it replaces. Keys are authored ascending sm -> 2xl because Tailwind emits @media blocks in config order.
